from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def index(i, n):
        block, offset = divmod(i, n)
        return offset if block == 1 else n - 1 - offset
    return [[grid[index(r, h)][index(c, w)] for c in range(3 * w)] for r in range(3 * h)]
'''
p=programs/'task-e4a2f0ba.py'
p.write_text(source)
namespace={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),namespace)
transform=namespace['transform']
